titleTr: Önekler: un-, dis-, re-, mis- (eğitim haberi)

grammar.topic: Kelime türetme: önekler un-, dis-, re-, mis-
explainTr: Önek (prefix), kelimenin başına eklenip anlamını değiştirir; yazımı değişmez. 'un-' ve 'dis-' çoğunlukla 'tersi, değil' demektir: fair → unfair, agree → disagree. 'Un-' genellikle sıfatlarla gelir (unhappy, unable), 'dis-' fiil ve sıfatlarla (disconnect, dishonest).

're-' 'tekrar' demektir: write → rewrite, open → reopen. 'mis-' 'yanlış, hatalı' demektir: understand → misunderstand, lead → mislead. Bu dört önek eğitim haberlerinde çok geçer: unprepared, reopen, misunderstand, disapprove.
Hangi önekin hangi kelimeyle geldiğini kural değil alışkanlık belirler (disfair demeyiz). Yeni bir kelimeyle karşılaşınca önce öneki, sonra kökü ayırarak anlamı tahmin et.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede olumsuzluk genelde sonekle yapılır (adil → adil-siz, anlamak → anla-ma-mak). İngilizcede ise kelimenin başına önek eklersin: fair → un-fair, understand → mis-understand.

reading.title: Washington Elementary reopens
reading.text:
When Washington Elementary School reopens its doors on Monday, students will walk into a very different building. After a burst pipe flooded the first floor last winter, the district decided to rebuild the library and replace the old floors. The work took almost eight months, and many families were unhappy about the long wait.

At first, parents were dissatisfied with the lack of information. Some said they were unaware of the schedule, while others misunderstood a letter and thought the school would reopen in September. "The announcement was confusing," said one mother. "I do not think anyone meant to mislead us, but we felt unprepared." The principal, Dr. Alvarez, admitted that the district could have communicated better. "We apologize," she said. "Next time, we will rewrite our letters in plain English and send them earlier."

The students, however, did not seem to disapprove of the delay. For months they attended classes at a nearby church hall, where the rooms were unfamiliar and a bit cold. "It was strange at first," said fifth grader Maya, "but our teachers made it fun. We even had a class pet." Teachers admit that moving was difficult. Wi-Fi often disconnected during lessons, and several staff members had to reconsider their lesson plans at the last minute.

Now the building has new lights, a larger reading corner, and a computer lab with fast internet. The district also added a "buddy program" in which older students help younger ones feel comfortable. Community volunteers, including several parents, painted the hallways over two weekends.

Some residents still believe the project was unfair because it cost more than expected. Others argue that a safe, modern school is worth the price. Whatever people think, one fact is clear: on Monday morning, hundreds of children will return to their classrooms, and the building will be full of noise again.

Dr. Alvarez has one final request for families. "If you misread any message from us, please call the front office," she said. "We would rather answer a question twice than leave you uncertain."

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Mom, did you read the article about Washington Elementary? It reopens on Monday.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, I did. It says the library was rebuilt after the flood.

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Right. But some parents were unhappy because the letters were confusing.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I understand them. If you misread one date, you can bring your child on the wrong day.

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Exactly. One mom said she was completely unaware of the new schedule.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That is unfair. A school should always inform families clearly.

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: The principal apologized, though. She promised to rewrite the letters.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good. Honest communication is important. Did they say anything about volunteers?

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Yes. They need help on Monday morning, because the students will feel a little nervous in the new building.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Maybe I can go. I would love to see the new reading corner.

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: I think you should. It could be good practice for your substitute work.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: You are right. I will call the front office this afternoon.

writing.promptTr: Bir okulun yeniden açıldığını anlatan kısa bir haber yaz (120-180 kelime). En az dört öneklı kelime kullan (reopen, unfair, misunderstand, dissatisfied, disagree...).
writing.promptEn: Write a short news report (120-180 words) about a school that reopens after repairs. Use at least four words with the prefixes un-, dis-, re- or mis-.
frames: After months of repairs, ... will reopen on ...
Many parents were unaware ... / dissatisfied with ...
writing.model: After six months of repairs, Oak Street Elementary will reopen on Monday morning. A storm damaged the roof last winter, and the district decided to rebuild the library and replace the old windows. At first, many parents were dissatisfied because they were unaware of the schedule. Some people even misunderstood a letter and thought the school would reopen in the fall. The principal admitted that the information was confusing and apologized. She promised to rewrite future letters in simple language. Some residents disagree about the cost, and they say the project was unfair to other schools. Others believe that a safe, modern building is worth the money. Teachers say they are excited, although they are still unprepared for the big move back. Volunteers will help students find their new classrooms. Everyone hopes that the first day will go smoothly and that the building will be full of happy children again.
checklistTr: En az dört öneklı kelime kullandın mı?
Önekleri doğru köke ekledin mi (unfair, disagree, reopen, mislead)?
Haber üslubu: geçmiş ve gelecek zamanı tutarlı kullandın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
